summary: BLOOM money. is a small Gold Coast/Brisbane outsourced-finance and virtual CFO practice run by sisters Jaimie Scott (CPA) and Olivia (CA), with a strong e-commerce client base. Jaimie recently spoke on a podcast about Shopify vs Xero numbers and A2X, and shared her Xero/Dext/Fathom stack; the firm advertised a Senior Accountant role in 2026 aimed at cutting busywork.

hooks.text: Jaimie's podcast on Shopify vs Xero numbers and her A2X comment, with the point that files can nearly auto-reconcile: Vert handles the residual reconciliation that connectors leave.
Hiring a Senior Accountant while valuing less busywork suggests capacity pressure on reconciliation and month-end.
Her own tech-stack video (Dext, Xero, Fathom) shows she is tool-curious; ask where reconciliation still bottlenecks.

risks.text: Already runs automation (A2X, Dext); may see little gap. Very small team.
Homepage appears to contain injected casino spam; website may be compromised, treat site content with care.

gaps: Podcast and tech-stack video dates not shown on pages (podcast date unknown).

first.subject: Reconciling Shopify and Xero at Bloom
first.body:
Hi Jaimie, I read the transcript of your Bright Red Marketing episode on why Shopify and the Xero profit and loss almost never match, including your point that A2X can get a file close to reconciling automatically. I also saw Bloom is hiring a Senior Accountant and values cutting out busywork. I built Vert to turn hours of manual reconciliation into minutes, with a trail you can trace instead of AI that guesses. Where do the leftover manual reconciliations sit for your eCommerce clients, after A2X and Dext?

Best,
Dawoud
Vert | https://vertfinance.tech

followUp.subject: Re: Reconciling Shopify and Xero at Bloom
followUp.body:
